Fondaparinux is eliminated renally and should be used with caution in patients with renal impairment. US licensed product information contra- indicates its use in patients with creatinine clearance (CC) below 30 mL/minute, and advises caution in those with CC between 30 and 50 mL/minute. UK licensed product information contra-in- dicates its use in patients with creatinine clearance (CC) below 20 mL/minute; for patients with CC between 20 and 50 mL/minute a subcutaneous dose of 1.5 mg once daily is rec- ommended for prophylaxis of venous thromboembolism, but no dosage alteration is required for unstable angina or myocardial infarction.
